content.text:
I'd commit all three. They're the shared project config for the Entire CLI, and the private stuff is already excluded.

What's in each one:

| Path | Contents | Commit? |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude/settings.json` | Claude Code hooks that call `entire`, plus a rule that stops Claude from reading `.entire/metadata/` | Yes |
| `.codex/hooks.json` | The same hooks for Codex | Yes |
| `.entire/settings.json` | Entire config (enabled, telemetry off, checkpoints stored as git refs) | Yes |
| `.entire/.gitignore` | Already excludes `tmp/`, `metadata/`, `logs/`, `settings.local.json` | Yes |
| `.entire/metadata/`, `logs/`, `tmp/` | Your prompts and session logs | Already ignored, so they stay local |

**Why commit them:**
- Anyone who clones the repo, or you on another machine, gets session capture working without setting it up again.
- They do no harm to people who don't use Entire. Every hook checks whether `entire` is installed and exits quietly if it isn't.
- Nothing secret is in them: no tokens, no paths specific to your machine.

**One thing to add:** create a root `.gitignore` with `.claude/settings.local.json`. That's where Claude Code saves your personal permission approvals, and those should stay local. It doesn't exist yet, but it will show up once you approve things in a session.

The only reason to keep these out of the repo would be if you don't want anyone to see that you used Claude, Codex or Entire. If that's the case, put all three folders in `.gitignore` instead.

Want me to create the `.gitignore` and make the first commit?

---

Apply for your key · Brief · API docs · Starter kit · Build page · Results · Discord

You are the procurement team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke, a fictional German pump maker, and the inbox is full: a foundry wants +9.5 %, a framework contract expires, a new pump needs three quotes. Build an **AI buyer agent** that reads the company's data, negotiates by e-mail with our supplier bots, and closes the best total deal, or walks away. Practise all weekend against our hosted suppliers. On Sunday at 12:00 a Live Final on hidden cases ranks every team. This repo holds everything you need: the brief, the API docs, a Python starter kit and the data package. Bring your own LLM, any provider; we run the suppliers. ## Start in 15 minutes You need Python 3.12, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and git. 1. **Apply.** Open **https://arena.tacto.ai/apply** and enter your team name and a contact e-mail. Tip: start the name with one emoji, it shows on the big screen. 2. **Show your match code at the Tacto desk.** We approve. 3. **Copy your key.** It appears **once** on the page you applied on; then press "Got the key". One key per team. Lost it? We reset it at the desk. 4. **Run the four commands.** ```bash git clone https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit.git cd negotiation-arena-kit/starter-kit cp .env.example .env # paste your key: ARENA_API_KEY=... uv sync --all-extras # install uv run arena me # your team and its practice quota uv run arena play case:P01 # the naive example agent negotiates one practice case uv run arena board # your team on the practice leaderboard ``` `arena play` prints the deal, your score and a replay link: every e-mail and the supplier's reasons in words. Read it, improve your agent, play again. Next steps, the LLM agent and your own agent: [starter-kit/README.md](starter-kit/README.md). ## Links | What | Where | |---|---| | Apply for your key | https://arena.tacto.ai/apply | | Brief: story, task, score, rules | [brief/brief.md](brief/brief.md) | | API docs | [brief/api.md](brief/api.md) | | Starter kit: client, example agents, Live Final runner, local simulator, MCP server | [starter-kit/](starter-kit/) | | Submission and pitch | [brief/submission.md](brief/submission.md) | | Practice build page: every team's quota, records and highlights | https://arena.tacto.ai/live | | Live Final results, team by team and case by case | https://arena.tacto.ai/results | | Questions | Discord https://discord.gg/hPwFfbWRV · the Tacto table | ## The weekend at a glance | When | What | |---|---| | Sat 10:00 | Kickoff and reveal: brief, data, kit and practice arena go live | | Sat 12:00-13:00 | **Deep dive**, ground floor (room on the signs): data, API, kit, Q&A. Bring a laptop. Challenge selection closes 13:00 | | Sat afternoon | Office hours at the Tacto table. Practice all weekend: 200 sessions per team per 24 hours | | Sat evening | We post on Discord when Tacto goes offline for the night | | Sun 08:00 | **New market data.** Run `uv run arena data` again; hidden cases may cite it | | Sun 09:00 | Pre-flight: one practice case through your final setup | | Sun 12:00 | **Code freeze**, submit on ehl.gg. **Live Final**: five waves, 8 minutes each, every team at once | | Sun 13:00 | **Top 10 pitch** to the Tacto jury: 5 minutes + 2 minutes of questions | | Sun 14:30 | Track winners and the two finalists announced | | Sun 15:30 | Grand Final pitches (AudiMax) | | Sun 16:30 | Awards | ## Rules that matter - **No human in the loop** during the Live Final. Start your agent before 12:00 and leave it running: `uv run arena run --set final --agent llm --parallel 10` picks up each wave by itself. - **Your agent must not read the live feed** during the Live Final: `/v1/events`, `/screen`, `/leaderboard`, `/results` and their JSON. They are for you, not for your agent. - **One key per team.** No attacks on the service or on other teams. - Everything else counts, including weaknesses you find in our suppliers. Every replay is open to the jury. All rules: [brief, section 7](brief/brief.md#7-rules). ## What to submit on ehl.gg by Sun 12:00 - **Your repo** with the agent and a README that says how to run it, and the **commit hash** your agent runs in the final. The jury and tum.ai must be able to open it. - **A short description** of your approach. - **Slides** for the pitch. The top 10 pitch from 13:00. Details: [brief/submission.md](brief/submission.md). ## Prizes 1st place €1,500 · medals for the top 3 · the best 2 EHL finalist teams in this track go on to the Grand Final. ⟦Q2: how the Live Final score and the jury combine for places 1-3⟧ ## What is in this repo | Folder | What | |---|---| | [`brief/`](brief/) | The brief, the API docs, the submission guide | | [`starter-kit/`](starter-kit/) | Python client, a naive and an LLM example agent, the Live Final runner, `arena-sim` (the API on your laptop), an MCP server over the data | | [`data/`](data/) | Data package v1: CSV, SQLite, `facts.json`, contracts, letters, notes. The same as `https://arena.tacto.ai/v1/data/package.zip`; start with [`data/README.md`](data/README.md) | The company, its suppliers and all names are fictional; the market indices are real open series ([`data/ATTRIBUTION.md`](data/ATTRIBUTION.md)). ## Licence Code: MIT ([LICENSE](LICENSE)).
